verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say workflows can be automated with rules and webhooks, and that threshold alerts on run count, cost, errors, feedback score and latency can be routed to any HTTP endpoint via webhook. That covers the core of subscribing to platform events over webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types beyond alerts and rule matches, payload schema, delivery/retry and signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
